pages.title: A Reef with Character
pages.text: Reefstone and sea pickles provide a sturdy lit platform for the living aquatic display.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep the urchin underwater; land is fatal. Its head carries an item and bundles follow native rules. Use the fieldguide/recipe view for the supported Clam-and-Prismarine cosmetic recipe.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Jade integration supplies information for some specialized Spawn interactions such as stickbugs and octopus-locked chests. Potential in-game inspection tutorial.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Clams and Prismarine to change a compatible mob's appearance. A native advancement explicitly recognizes this cosmetic interaction, separate from cooking clams.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Keep a Sea Urchin underwater and place an item on its head. Native lore documents head-item carrying and Bundle stacking behavior; it dies outside water.
